name: 34769 · Saint Cloud, FL
findings: ZIP 34769 (Saint Cloud) has 82 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34769 (Saint Cloud) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34769 (Saint Cloud) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
